name: Camp Billings
description_short: Camp Billings is an overnight camp in Fairlee, Vermont, with four two-week sessions for campers ages 8 to 15. The daily schedule is the same all summer, and each session has its own special events, such as the 4th of July, the Musical, or Country Fair.
refund_policy_summary: $500 deposit per camper per session. The deposit is fully refunded if you cancel within two weeks of receiving your registration confirmation. After that, cancelling (including switching or dropping sessions) forfeits the deposit and all tuition paid so far. For a serious illness or injury, tuition minus the deposit is refunded with a written doctor's note. Full tuition is due April 30, 2027.
special_needs_notes: The camp says its staff are not trained or equipped to support children with extensive physical, emotional, or educational needs. Families should contact Executive Director Yutaka Tamura before registering to discuss any special considerations.
